subject: mathematics
concept: A fraction represents equal parts of one whole
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student divides a physical (on-screen) pizza into equal slices
exercise.pictorial: Student labels a bar model showing 1/4, 2/4, 3/4
exercise.abstract: Student writes the fraction for a shaded shape

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile (e.g. basketball stats instead of pizza, if that's the student's interest)
